commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Juan Pulido has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+5' This is a yellow card! Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+4' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.
90+4' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid)! Let's see what he decides.
90+3' Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Pulido had an easy-decision to make.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' A pass by Rodrygo (Real Madrid) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
87' Substitution. Federico Valverde makes his way off the pitch and Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) comes on as his replacement.
87' Carlo Ancelotti decides to make a substitution. Joselu will be replaced by Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid).
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) is coming onto the pitch as Yangel Herrera cannot continue after picking up an injury.
84' The referee is firm and issues Kepa Arrizabalaga (Real Madrid) a deserved yellow card.
82' Daley Blind (Girona) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Juan Pulido saw the whole situation.
79' A substitution has been made. Savio is replaced by Pablo Torre (Girona).
79' The Real Madrid players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
76' The referee blows for a cooling break.
74' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to make a change. Daniel Ceballos (Real Madrid) replaces Jude Bellingham.

71' 0 - 3 What a goal! Joselu plays it to Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Paulo Gazzaniga into the left side of the goal. 0:3.
70' Savio (Girona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
69' Vinicius Junior goes off the pitch and Rodrygo (Real Madrid) comes on.
67' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
64' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Eric Garcia (Girona) was quite harsh and Juan Pulido didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
64' The goalkeeper pulls off a remarkable reflex save to deny a rebound from Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid)! That was a huge opportunity!
64' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
60' Michel has decided to substitute Artem Dovbyk and he is replaced by Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
60' It's time for a substitution. Portu (Girona) comes on in place of David Lopez.
58' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
56' Yangel Herrera (Girona) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
55' Yangel Herrera (Girona) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and sends his header just over the bar.
55' Corner kick. Aleix Garcia (Girona) is ready to send the ball into the box.

54' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Juan Pulido blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick is awarded to Girona.
53' Savio (Girona) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
51' Juan Pulido couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) and blew his whistle.

50' David Lopez (Girona) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the resulting free kick. His header would have probably ended up in the middle of the goal, but Kepa Arrizabalaga pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
49' Yangel Herrera (Girona) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
49' The ball is cleared after Savio (Girona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
48' One of the Real Madrid players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
46' Substitution. Viktor Tsygankov makes way for Valery (Girona).
46' Referee Juan Pulido blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Real Madrid force a corner. They send men into the box.

45+4' A sweet pass finds Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the roof of the net. Paulo Gazzaniga is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The ball goes out for a corner. Real Madrid can continue in their attacking effort.
45+2' Great teamplay by Real Madrid as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
42' Yangel Herrera (Girona) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
40' The opposition give Aleix Garcia (Girona) far too much space and he has a go from long range, but the goal isn't threatened as the ball goes well wide of the left post.
39' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Savio (Girona), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. It's a throw-in for Girona.
38' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
37' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
34' Girona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
32' A cooling break is underway.
31' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
28' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the left side of the goal. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
25' A clumsy foul by Joselu (Real Madrid) and Juan Pulido blows his whistle.
21' 0 - 2 Toni Kroos takes the corner and Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) rises highest near the penalty spot to plant a brilliant header into the left side of the goal. The score is 0:2.
21' Real Madrid earn a corner.
20' Neat passing move from Real Madrid in order to create new attacking opportunities.
17' 0 - 1 Goal! Jude Bellingham puts a cross into the box and finds Joselu (Real Madrid), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the middle of the net. He makes it 0:1.
16' Eric Garcia (Girona) heads the ball towards the left post of the goal, but his attempt is denied by the goalkeeper.
14' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
12' Real Madrid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
11' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Joselu (Real Madrid), but the defence gets it clear. The ball is out of play. Real Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner.
10' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) makes a strong challenge and Juan Pulido blows for a foul.
8' Girona enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
4' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the left post.
3' Yangel Herrera (Girona) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header narrowly over the crossbar!
2' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Real Madrid will have the kick-off.
Juan Pulido will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
